plaatsen.tekst: Jesus answered, My kingdom is not of this world: if my kingdom were of this world, then would my servants fight, that I should not be delivered to the Jews: but now is my kingdom not from hence.
Fight the good fight of faith, lay hold on eternal life, whereunto thou art ➔ also called, and hast professed a good profession before many witnesses.
And every man that striveth for the mastery is temperate in all things. Now they do it to obtain a corruptible crown; but we an incorruptible.
I have fought a good fight, I have finished my course, I have kept the faith:
Whereunto I also labour, striving according to his working, which worketh in me mightily.
Epaphras, who is one of you, a servant of Christ, saluteth you, always labouring fervently for you in prayers, that ye may stand perfect and complete in all the will of God.
Strive to enter in at the strait gate: for many, I say unto you, will seek to enter in, and shall not be able.
